notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3537740/Stick_Robot_Puzzle_Demo"][/dynamiclink]I've updated the demo version of StickRobotPuzzle.[/p]
[p]There are no changes to the puzzle content itself, but...[/p]
[list]
[*][p]Added "mysteries" to the world map (you'll be able to solve them in the full version)[/p][/*]
[*][p]Adjusted controls to feel more intuitive[/p][/*]
[*][p]Made the player robot feel more squishy[/p][/*]
[*][p]Added ambient sounds[/p][/*]
[*][p]Other minor changes[/p][/*]
[/list]
[p]...and more.[/p]
[p]The full version is almost complete and should be released in August![/p]
[p]HIKO[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you for checking out the game!

The demo has been updated.

[b]While the stages themselves haven't changed, a world map has been added, allowing you to move around the world as part of the puzzle.[/b]

In addition, a Linux version is now available!
[b]It works on Steam Deck.[/b]

We hope you enjoy it!
